screen: In-call screen (TGCallViewController) — avatar/name/status, mute/speaker/end/answer buttons, post-call rating panel
originalCounterpart: No call UI existed in the 2013 source (telegram_iphone.src has only the phone TL RPCs). Chrome reference: /Users/alexanderhavrysh/Git/iOS/telegram-original-sources/extracted/telegram_iphone.src/Telegraph/Telegraph/TGButtonsMenuItemView.m, TGButtonMenuItemCell.m, TGInterfaceAssets.mm, TGProfileController.m. Call semantics/strings reference: /Users/alexanderhavrysh/Git/iOS/twelve/Telegraph/TGCallInfoView.m, TGCallButtonsView.m, TGCallRatingView.m, TGCallController.mm, en.lproj/Localizable.strings

findings.ours: Ongoing-call status is a bare, non-padded timer: "%ld:%02ld" giving "0:05" (src/TGCallViewController.m:496-500)
findings.theirs: Status is TGLocalized("Call.StatusOngoing") = "Telegram Audio %@" with a zero-padded duration "%02d:%02d" (and "%02d:%02d:%02d" past an hour)
findings.fix: In -tick, format duration as [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02d:%02d", (int)(seconds/60)%60, (int)seconds%60] (three-part %02d:%02d:%02d at >= 3600) and set statusLabel.text to [NSString stringWithFormat:@"Telegram Audio %@", durationString].

findings.ours: Incoming-call accept button is titled "Answer" and the red button is always "End" (src/TGCallViewController.m:143,149)
findings.theirs: Accept button uses Call.Accept = "Accept"; the incoming-call red button uses Call.Decline = "Decline", switching to the end action only once the call is ongoing
findings.fix: Title the green button "Accept", and title the red button "Decline" while state is None/Pending on an incoming call, switching it to "End" when the call reaches Established.

findings.ours: Status strings are invented and sentence-cased: "Calling...", "Incoming call", "Exchanging keys...", "Call ended", "Call failed" (src/TGCallViewController.m:422,426,432,452,457)
findings.theirs: "Contacting..." (requesting), "Waiting...", "Ringing..." (peer received), "Telegram Audio..." (incoming/handshake), "Connecting..." (accepting/handshake — there is no "Exchanging keys" string anywhere), title-cased "Call Ended" and "Call Failed"
findings.fix: Outgoing pending -> "Contacting..." then "Ringing..." once the peer has it; incoming pending -> "Telegram Audio..."; ExchangingKeys and Connecting -> "Connecting..."; ended -> "Call Ended"; failed -> "Call Failed".

findings.ours: Every non-failure termination collapses to "Call ended"; there is no busy and no no-answer state (src/TGCallViewController.m:451-460)
findings.theirs: Terminal state distinguishes Call.StatusBusy = "Busy" and Call.StatusNoAnswer = "No Answer" from Call.StatusEnded before falling back to "Call Ended"
findings.fix: In -applyState, before the generic ended text, map the discard reason to "Busy" and "No Answer" (and keep the server error path on "Call Failed").

findings.ours: The whole screen is laid out once in viewDidLoad against self.view.bounds and never re-laid-out; nothing overrides shouldAutorotateToInterfaceOrientation (src/TGCallViewController.m:90-155)
findings.theirs: Call chrome recomputes every frame in layoutSubviews from the current view size, so a rotation reflows the labels and buttons
findings.fix: Move the avatar/name/status/button frame math out of viewDidLoad into -viewDidLayoutSubviews (or a -layoutViews called from it), or pin the controller to portrait by returning only UIInterfaceOrientationIsPortrait from shouldAutorotateToInterfaceOrientation:.

findings.ours: The MenuRedButton title shadow is plain black at 30% — [UIColor colorWithWhite:0.0f alpha:0.3f] (src/TGCallViewController.m:264)
findings.theirs: The red menu button's title shadow is UIColorRGBA(0xa10603, 0.5f) at offset (0,-1), for both normal and highlighted
findings.fix: Replace the black 0.3 shadow in the non-green branch of -buttonWithTitle:asset:frame:action: with rgba(0xA10603, 0.5).

findings.ours: Rating panel heading is "Rate this call" on one line (src/TGCallViewController.m:603)
findings.theirs: Calls.RatingTitle = "Please rate the quality\nof your Telegram call" — two lines
findings.fix: Set ratingTitleLabel.text to @"Please rate the quality\nof your Telegram call", numberOfLines = 2, and grow the label frame from 22 to about 40pt, shifting the stars down accordingly.

findings.theirs: The rating alert's done button is Calls.SubmitRating = "Submit" (the "Send" string belongs to the separate technical-log alert)
findings.fix: Title the green rating button "Submit". ("Not Now" on the left is already correct — Calls.NotNow, strings:2053.)

findings.theirs: Placeholder is Calls.RatingFeedback = "Write a comment...", swapping to Call.ReportPlaceholder = "What went wrong?" when 1-3 stars are selected
findings.fix: Default the placeholder to "Write a comment..."; in -starPressed:, set it to "What went wrong?" when stars is 1-3 and back to "Write a comment..." for 4.

findings.ours: Six invented problem chips (Echo / Noise / Interruptions / Distorted speech / Silent remote / Dropped) are drawn as hand-rolled 30pt rounded-rect buttons with a CoreGraphics border and a 0.12-white fill (src/TGCallViewController.m:632-658)
findings.theirs: The rating sheet is stars plus a single free-text comment view only; the qualitative detail is collected as text, and technical detail through a separate "Send technical information" alert — there is no chip grid
findings.fix: Drop the chip grid and keep the comment field as the only detail control (keep sending problem keys derived from the free text if the API needs them); if the chips are kept as a deliberate extra, plate them with GroupedActionButton art rather than a hand-drawn border, since no bordered-translucent-chip control exists in the 2013 kit.

findings.ours: Stars are the Unicode glyphs "☆"/"★" in systemFontOfSize:30 inside 44x44 buttons laid out edge to edge (src/TGCallViewController.m:613-629)
findings.theirs: Stars are the CallStar / CallStar_Highlighted images in 42x38 buttons, laid out at x = 18 + 42*i inside a 246x38 strip, with adjustsImageWhenHighlighted disabled and selection driven by the highlighted image
findings.fix: There is no CallStar PNG in images/ yet, so either add it and use 42x38 buttons at x = 18 + 42*i (strip width 246, height 38) with a normal/selected image pair, or, if the glyphs stay, match the geometry: 42x38 buttons, 38pt strip height, no per-button background.

findings.ours: The speaker button relabels itself "Earpiece" when speaker is on (src/TGCallViewController.m:522)
findings.theirs: The speaker control keeps a single label, Call.AudioRouteSpeaker = "Speaker", and expresses the on state through the control's selected state; no "Earpiece" string exists in the catalogue
findings.fix: Keep the title "Speaker" in both states and show the on state with the button's _Highlighted plate (setBackgroundImage:…forState:UIControlStateSelected plus button.selected = speakerOn).

findings.ours: The side-by-side button pair is separated by 8pt: buttonWidth = (int)((width - 9*2 - 8) / 2) (src/TGCallViewController.m:128, and again at :635,673)
findings.theirs: The paired grouped-action row uses a 10pt gutter: buttonWidth = floorf((contentWidth - 10) / 2), left at x=0 and right flush to the right edge of the 9pt-inset content width
findings.fix: Change the three occurrences to (int)((b.size.width - 9*2 - 10) / 2), i.e. 146pt each at 320 wide, right button at x = 320 - 9 - 146 = 165.

findings.ours: A disabled/unavailable action button is dimmed to alpha 0.5 (src/TGCallViewController.m:684,719)
findings.theirs: Disabled menu buttons are dimmed to alpha 0.7
findings.fix: Use 0.7f instead of 0.5f for the disabled Send/Submit button alpha.

findings.ours: Stars respond only to a tap on an individual star button (src/TGCallViewController.m:625-626)
findings.theirs: A UIPanGestureRecognizer on the stars strip lets the rating be dragged across, setting whichever star the finger is over
findings.fix: Add a pan recognizer on the stars container that hit-tests the star buttons on state-changed and calls -starPressed: for the one under the clamped x.

findings.ours: docs/design-language/components.md:374-377 tells agents that GroupedActionButton text is "boldSystemFontOfSize:14 white with the standard (0,-1) shadow" for both the neutral and the affirmative form, and gives MenuRedButton as "cap 12, height 45" with no label spec
findings.theirs: The neutral GroupedActionButton label is #4A6587 with an rgba(0xFFFFFF, 0.45) shadow at (0,+1) — white/(0,-1) applies only to the green form (shadow rgba(0x124606,0.3)); the red MenuRedButton label is boldSystemFontOfSize:17 white with rgba(0xA10603,0.5) at (0,-1), and its image is stretched with topCapHeight = height/2 = 22, not 0
findings.fix: Correct components.md:374-377 to split neutral (#4A6587 label, rgba(#FFFFFF,0.45) shadow at (0,1), bold 14) from affirmative (white label, rgba(#124606,0.3) at (0,-1), bold 16 when paired), and add to the MenuRedButton row at components.md:283 the top cap 22 and the label spec bold 17 / white / rgba(#A10603,0.5) at (0,-1). typography-colour.md:132 already has the neutral colours right, so the two files currently contradict each other.
